_comment_top: v1.4.0 per-outlet BC types example. Treat as a template — drop your STLs + CSV in cases_input/<case_id>/, then run with `python run_patient.py <case_id> --config <this file>`. The 'outlets.per_outlet' block is what's new here; the rest is a standard pulsatile arterial config.

case_info.description: Demonstrates outlets.per_outlet (v1.4.0): one outlet pinned to a fixed reference pressure, others modelled with 3-element Windkessel.

transport_properties._comment: Standard blood properties: mu=0.004 Pa·s → nu=3.77e-6 m²/s

outlets._comment: Default for unspecified outlets. outlet2, outlet3, outlet4 inherit this 3-element Windkessel.

per_outlet._comment: Per-outlet overrides. The named outlets get this type; everything else falls back to 'outlets.type'.

outlet1._comment: Pin outlet1 to a clinical reference pressure (e.g. inferior vena cava / venous baseline).
